items.name: GoodsID → ItemID
items.evidence: ShopID→GroupID→GoodsID static path exists; 17 Item.QuickBuyID reverse links, including 2001501→1237913, 2006901→1237925, 1933001/2/3→1281001/2/3; 1900101 has no reverse link. L2C_Goods.itemId is sent in shop responses; ShopGoodsGroup has no ItemID.
items.recommended_action: Seek successful historical L2C_ShopGoods responses; preserve 17 reverse links as hints, not complete catalog; do not infer nearby IDs.

items.name: GoodsID → Num
items.evidence: ShopGoodsGroup has no Num. L2C_Goods.num and L2C_BuyGoods.itemNum are response fields; no quantity for any of six targeted GoodsID in extracted tables.
items.recommended_action: Require a successful shop response or label any Revival quantity as a compatibility rule; never assume one.

items.name: 随机店抽取与上架
items.evidence: Static group, condition and season-group references exist; L2C_ShopGoods and L2C_RefreshShop carry the actual listed goods. No complete selection algorithm was established in client static data.
items.recommended_action: Collect historical snapshots across refreshes; otherwise keep shop unavailable or explicitly define a Revival catalog and selection policy.

items.name: 商店限购/刷新
items.evidence: Limited is E_Day/E_Week without a count; L2C_Goods carries canBuyTimes/hasBuyTimes, shop responses carry NextRefreshTime/RefreshTimes/RefreshPrice. ShopGoodsGroup.RefreshInterval is a purchase-count price tier threshold in ShopModule.GetInterval/CalNumPrice, not a time unit. ShopConfig.ShopRefreshTime=[5,18] lacks proven time-zone semantics.
items.recommended_action: Use response samples to recover quota and reset behavior; define any Revival time zone and schedule explicitly as compatibility rules.

items.name: DropValueID → DropClass/Item
items.evidence: 10610001, 10610801 and 10630101 occur only as Section.DropValueID in extracted tables; 341 distinct DropValueID have no numeric overlap with DropProp.DropClass, DropBase.ID or Gift.GiftGroup. Runtime FightDataProfile.DropValues is populated; DropItemManager.AddDropItem passes its dropGroup parameter, not Section.DropValueID, to DropPropManager.GetItem.
items.recommended_action: Require battle profile and settlement samples linked to a Section; do not invent mapping or probabilities.

items.name: 日/周重置
items.evidence: TaskControl ID=5 has DailyRefresh=5 and WeeklyRefresh=5. Static code inspected does not prove unit, time zone, week boundary or cross-period semantics; client displays server task snapshots.
items.recommended_action: Specify Revival time zone and reset boundaries as compatibility rules only; do not call value 5 an official hour or weekday.

items.name: 活跃宝箱
items.evidence: TaskControl daily thresholds 20/40/60/80/100 and gift groups 760001–760005, seasonal 760016–760020; weekly thresholds 30/60/90/120/150 and gift groups 760010–760014. TreasureBoxData boxId/pickStatus/activityId used for both types; pickStatus 1=ready UI, 2=opened UI, other=closed UI. Claim request sends UI index as boxId. Seasonal daily gift preview checks activity 55. Actual index base and grant need response samples.
items.recommended_action: Get nonempty daily/weekly boxList and claim receipts to confirm boxId indexing, state transition and actual reward.

items.name: 任务业务事件
items.evidence: Forty task definitions and condition targets are static; successful enhancement, training, expedition, friend and alchemy operations are not all bound to progress events.
items.recommended_action: Count only verified successful operations; targeted handler tracing is worthwhile for events planned for implementation.

items.name: 击杀任务
items.evidence: FightKillInfo carries unit/count telemetry, but class mapping, duplicate handling and binding to verified battle settlement are unproven.
items.recommended_action: Do not count unverified reports; trace FightKillInfo through battle receipt and define a trusted Revival accounting rule if needed.

items.name: 战斗体力
items.evidence: Section.ManualValue=6 is static; first clear, story chaining, failed battle and exit charge/refund timing are not confirmed.
items.recommended_action: Keep current admission rule until historical enter/settle/exit responses or explicit Revival charge/refund policy is available.

items.name: 经验升级
items.evidence: Gift experience quantities are known and resource accounting exists; player/hero threshold, cap and hero upgrade operation are not fully connected to protocol handlers.
items.recommended_action: Target experience table fields and upgrade handlers before enabling automatic level changes.

items.name: 装备实例与特殊货币奖励
items.evidence: Some Gift entries resolve to equipment or extra-currency ItemID; instance property generation and destination currency sync are missing.
items.recommended_action: Seek grant response examples and continue atomic refusal of rewards whose target is unknown; never guess equipment rolls.

items.name: 战斗校验
items.evidence: Revival has run UUID, session, settlement digest and durable receipt; official battleFile/sign validation and cross-session continuation are not recovered.
items.recommended_action: Keep current local run trust boundary; trace only the missing protocol paths needed for stronger validation.

items.name: 后续关卡准入
items.evidence: Sections 2110802–2110804 have static fixed rewards; story chaining, admission and complete reward flow remain unverified.
items.recommended_action: Preserve current two-section scope until progression and reward chain is verified or explicitly defined as Revival compatibility.
